naslov: GitHub Spec Kit: spec-first workflows for Claude Code and Copilot | AI Tool #7
opis:
An open-source tool that gives coding agents (Claude Code, Copilot and others) ready-made workflows and templates: spec first, then plan, then code.

How to try it:
1. Open github.com/github/spec-kit and read the installation guide
2. Initialize it in an existing Angular or SwiftUI project
3. Pick the "Spec-Driven Development" workflow and write a spec for one small feature
4. Let Claude Code go from planning through to implementation

Price: free

Official link: https://github.com/github/spec-kit

naslov: CC Auto Review: review GitHub pull requests with your local Claude Code | AI Tool #8
opis:
A macOS app that reviews GitHub pull requests using the Claude Code you already have installed locally.

How to try it:
1. Open the Product Hunt page and download the app
2. Check that Claude Code is installed and signed in
3. Connect a GitHub repo and run a review on one PR

Price: check the link

Official link: https://www.producthunt.com/products/cc-auto-review

naslov: What is an AI agent? AI explained in 30 seconds
opis:
An AI agent is an AI that doesn't just answer questions. It takes actions step by step, using tools like a browser or a phone, to finish a goal you give it. Example: Grok Bot can now call US numbers for paying users. It waits on hold, books appointments and negotiates bills, and the user is legally responsible for every call.
